title: Hayati Pro Max Blue Razz Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blue Razz Cherry blends the bold tang of Blue Raspberry with the sweet, jammy richness of Cherry for a vibrant and punchy fruit flavour. The Blue Raspberry delivers that familiar sweet-sour kick, while the Cherry note brings a smoother, rounded depth to the mix, resulting in a delightfully balanced and flavourful vape bursting with character. Crafted with nicotine salts, this e-liquid offers rapid nicotine delivery with a smoother, more comfortable throat hit—perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a clean, consistent vape with well-defined flavour and discreet vapour. Part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, this e-liquid is based on one of the brand’s bestselling disposable flavours—now available in convenient 10ml bottles, with a choice of 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength.
